create-workspace.summary: Create a test or live workspace and return its integration guide.

update-workspace.summary: Change a workspace's settings; on a live workspace this only returns a preview.

confirm-live-workspace-change.summary: Apply a live workspace change that was previewed, after the person agrees.

get-integration-guide.summary: Get what is needed to integrate one workspace: keys, URLs, SDK and webhook signing.

create-secret-key.summary: Create an inactive secret key in a workspace, for rotating keys.

activate-secret-key.summary: Make a secret key the active one; webhooks are signed with it.

delete-secret-key.summary: Delete an inactive secret key; requests signed with it stop being accepted.

list-verifications.summary: List verifications with filters, or count them by status.

get-verification.summary: Get the full detail of one verification, as shown in the admin UI.

get-verification-stats.summary: Get the dashboard's figures: volumes and how people's attempts ended.

create-verification.summary: Create a verification session and return the URL the person opens.

correct-document-fields.summary: Correct document fields the reader got wrong on a verification.

set-test-verification-outcome.summary: Set the final status of a verification in a test workspace and send its webhook.

list-webhook-deliveries.summary: List the webhook deliveries sent to your endpoints, newest first.

get-webhook-delivery-request.summary: Return the exact signed request of a test delivery, to replay against localhost.

retry-webhook-delivery.summary: Queue a failed webhook delivery to be sent again to the same endpoint.

resend-webhook-delivery.summary: Send a fresh copy of a webhook delivery to the same endpoint.

list-blocked-faces.summary: List blocked faces, including who blocked them and why.

prepare-block-verification-face.summary: Preview blocking a verification face and get a one-time challenge token.

confirm-block-verification-face.summary: Block a verification face with the challenge token, the phrase and a reason.

prepare-unblock-verification-face.summary: Preview unblocking a verification face and get a one-time challenge token.

confirm-unblock-verification-face.summary: Unblock a verification face with the challenge token, the phrase and a reason.

prepare-purge-personal-data.summary: Preview erasing a verification's personal data and get a challenge token.

confirm-purge-personal-data.summary: Erase a verification's personal data, irreversibly, for a real erasure request.

read-docs-page.summary: Read a page of the ProofAge developer docs, or list every page.
